parts.text: Which claim correctly predicts the unfolded design?

options.text: Two star stamps appear as mirror images across the fold line, because the fold forced matching positions to coincide.
The fold line itself is the stamped design.
One star appears anywhere on the paper, even where the layers did not meet.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Neel folds a square sheet once down the middle, stamps one star through both layers, then unfolds the sheet.

part_answers.answer: Folding makes matching positions coincide, so the stamp through both layers leaves two mirror-image stars across the fold line when the sheet is opened.

teacher.key_rationale: One fold then a stamp through both layers yields two mirror stars about the fold line. B swaps the fold line for the design. C drops the layers-coincide condition.
